clues.text: After Israel crossed the sea, a prophetess took a tambourine, and all the women followed her with dancing.
Beside the sea she sang, "Sing to the LORD, for the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea."
In the wilderness, she and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married.
As the cloud lifted from the Tent of Meeting, she suddenly became leprous, white as snow.
While Israel stayed at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, she died and was buried there.
Jochebed, wife of Amram the Levite, gave birth to her and to her brothers Aaron and Moses.
Through a prophet, God reminded Israel that He sent her before them out of Egypt, with Moses and Aaron.
